coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Verde
record.summary: Studio Gang's 23-story, 254-unit rental tower at 1070 Bridgeview Way, the fourth and last Phase 1 building. Construction started March 2022, leasing began April 2024, residents moved in from June 2024 and the ribbon was cut September 3, 2024; 59 of its units are below market rate after a 2024 re-mix toward 90% AMI.

facts.value: Mission Rock Partners (San Francisco Giants and Tishman Speyer) with equity partner Mitsui Fudosan America; vertical owner Mission Rock Parcel F Owner, L.L.C.
Port of San Francisco; 75-year prepaid parcel lease (Commercial Property Executive says it runs to 2095)
59 BMR units (23%): 35 at 90% AMI and 24 at 120% AMI, as approved April 9, 2024; the 2020 lease had set 97 (38%) including 29 at 150% AMI
314,508 total per the 2019 Port appraisal table; 287,000 per the developer's 2024 release; 315,000 per the 2026 refinancing report
21,600 sq ft of offices plus co-working (SF YIMBY); 25,000 sq ft co-working and event space (developer)
Eight ground-level retail spaces; tenants named include Arsicault Bakery, Quik Dog, Ike's Love & Sandwiches, LuxFit and Proper Food
LEED Gold (architect and developer said 'targeting' in 2024; the 2026 refinancing report calls it certified)
75 years, fully prepaid at execution (Lease No. L-16706, October 6, 2020)
Originally a later-phase block; swapped into Phase 1 for Parcel K in the 2019 Phase Submittal

costs.what: Appraised value of the 75-year prepaid Parcel F lease (development rights payment)
Minimum Mission Rock Jobs Housing Equivalency Fee subsidy received by Parcel F from the Phase 1 office parcels to fund its BMR units
Construction loan, Wells Fargo (as reported by Commercial Property Executive in 2026)

open_questions: Construction cost: not stated anywhere read; only the $116.2M Wells Fargo loan is on record.
Exact TCO date: the Port projected May then June 2024; no document read confirms the issued date.
Topping-out date: the Port's October 2023 memo only says it had topped out; no dated press item found.
Total square footage disagrees across sources (287,000 / 314,508 / 315,000); a permit record would settle it.

Images: no 'before' photo is hosted (until 2020 the parcel was the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot) and no rendering is hosted because the architects' renderings are not openly licensed; they are reachable through the architect sources listed here.

A Mapillary storefront photo of Ike's Love & Sandwiches (a sourced retail tenant, see the retail fact above) was hosted briefly and then removed: on review it read as too cluttered (a trash bin, a parked car and several pedestrians in front of the sign) to keep. Still on the shot list for a cleaner frame.
